registerServiceWorker

Registers <base>service-worker.js on window load when env.PROD is set. Exported (and env-injected) so the prod-only branch is exercisable in tests — import.meta.env does not exist outside Vite.

  • @param {object} env - Vite env object ({PROD, BASE_URL})
